reason: An agent workflow preset for dsh that structures engineering tasks through gated requirements, planning, TDD, parallel subagents, and verification phases.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 提供工程工作流智能体预设，通过需求澄清、计划审批、测试驱动开发、并行子智能体执行和验证完成五个阶段组织工程任务。
summaries.en: Adds a dsh engineering workflow agent preset that organizes tasks through requirements clarification, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagent execution, and verified finishing.

capabilities: Installs and synchronizes an agent preset and its workflow skills into the local dsh profile
Guides sessions through requirements clarification, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagent execution, and verification phases
Uses shell and test-running tools, filesystem access, planning tools, and delegated subagents through the configured preset
